name: ship
description: Assemble a spec-grounded PR and propose an afk/hitl routing. The outbound seam from local completion to a delivery pipeline. Run after /wrapup.

steps.name: Compose Intent block
steps.instruction: Resolve DEPLOY.md adapter. Write ## Intent from spec, ADR delta, and resolved concern decision lines. Never read the diff to describe the change (diff-derived Intent grades itself). Mark block 'spec-derived'.
checklist: Intent block written from spec (not diff)

steps.name: Assess autonomy and preconditions
steps.instruction: Precondition check: Intent present, every slice traces to acceptance criterion, tests green, no open blocking concern. Compose afk gate from 3 keys: (1a) every slice tagged afk, (1b) wrapup blocking verdict is 'none', (2) no diff path matches load-bearing glob. Propose afk iff all three hold; any failure -> hitl.

steps.name: Route and open PR
steps.instruction: Route per 2x3 engagement table. Print compact session digest and clickable link. Open or hold based on engagement tier. Surface reviewed-state as non-blocking note. Ship proposes, the target disposes.
checklist: PR opened or held per engagement

engagement.override: needs network and adapter; not Tier-1-offline

tone: Mechanical and honest. Ship proposes, the target disposes. Never imply afk means merged.
